skills.name: transcript-fixer

Triggers when working with ASR/STT output containing recognition errors, homophones, garbled technical terms, person-name errors, or Chinese/English mixed content. Also triggers on requests to clean up meeting notes, lecture transcripts, interview recordings, or any text produced by speech recognition. Use this skill even when the user just says "fix this transcript", "clean up these meeting notes", or mentions garbled names without invoking ASR specifically.

en.purpose: Corrects recurring and context-dependent speech-to-text errors while accumulating confirmed, domain-scoped correction knowledge for future transcripts.
scenarios: Apply safe dictionary corrections and defer risky matches for review.
Perform a full-document native AI pass for names, homophones, terminology, and mixed Chinese/English ASR errors.
Maintain project dictionaries, person-name variants, and domain context cues.
Queue uncertain entities or wording for anchored human review, optionally with audio playback.
Audit false positives, numeric damage, timestamps, and final transcript diffs.
Process multiple related transcripts while preserving per-file scope and reusable corrections.
en.io: Inputs include transcript text or Markdown, domain names, a SQLite correction database, optional people roster and context files, optional source audio, raw transcripts, and human review decisions. Outputs include corrected transcripts, Stage 1/2 and review sidecars, change and diff reports, persistent dictionary or review-queue records, and optional archived or renamed final files.
dependencies: uv for running bundled Python scripts and resolving inline dependencies
Bundled correction, review-dashboard, audio-fetch, timestamp, numeric-scan, split, and diff scripts
SQLite correction database under the transcript-fixer configuration directory
Optional people roster and per-domain context Markdown files
Claude native language review for the documented default AI phase
Optional GLM or Anthropic API credentials for standalone API mode
Optional lark-cli, curl, and ffprobe for Feishu/Lark audio retrieval and timeline validation
Optional audio file and local review dashboard for human adjudication
en.boundary: The evidence describes an extensive workflow rather than guaranteeing transcript accuracy. Dictionary replacements can create false positives; entity and numeric changes require evidence or human review, and uncertain text should remain unchanged. The workflow modifies local files and persistent SQLite state, may access external APIs in optional modes, and relies on many referenced scripts and documents whose implementations were not supplied here. Domain isolation, anchor integrity, raw-source preservation, and final diff review are essential limits stated by the source.

transcript-fixer 配置目录下的 SQLite 纠正数据库

Migrating legacy TTS pipelines from step-tts-2 to stepaudio-2.5-tts instruction-based schemas.

skills.name: claude-code-hooks
skills.summary: How to write, test, register, and debug Claude Code hooks — PreToolUse / PostToolUse / SessionStart / Stop Bash guards that enforce a rule the model would otherwise talk itself past. Use whenever the user wants to create a hook, block/intercept a tool call, turn a repeatedly-violated rule into a hard gate, add a guard rail, debug a hook that misfires or "poisons the session", register a hook across profiles, or mentions hooks / PreToolUse / Stop hook / 拦截 / 守卫 / 钩子 / 拦下. Bakes in the hard-won pitfalls: UserPromptSubmit only ever sees user input, never Claude's own text — a rule about Claude's own output belongs on Stop instead; token-level shlex matching (never awk splitting); bash -n + real-JSON end-to-end testing BEFORE registering (a corrupted PreToolUse hook poisons every Bash call); SSOT + symlink so a ~/.claude reinstall can't lose it; multi-profile convergence; and human-confirmation release gates. Reach for this even for "make it stop doing X" — a durable stop is a hook, not a reminder.

en.purpose: Provides end-to-end guidance for writing, testing, registering, and debugging Claude Code hooks to enforce hard structural guardrails on tool calls and model behavior.
scenarios: Blocking dangerous or irreversible shell commands using PreToolUse hooks.
Enforcing mandatory output verification or completion checks via Stop hooks.
Debugging misconfigured or misfiring hooks that disrupt Claude sessions.
Testing hook shell scripts end-to-end with real JSON payloads before registration.
en.io: Inputs natural language rule specifications or hook debugging requests and outputs validated shell hook scripts and JSON configurations.
en.boundary: It does not enforce subjective judgment rules without mechanical token patterns or pre-build guardrails for hypothetical, non-recurring errors.

构建多步骤的 UI 自动化测试或可视化报告工作流。
zh.io: 输入为窗口搜索关键字和视图控制指令，输出为保存的 PNG 或 JPEG 图像文件。
zh.boundary: 仅适用于 macOS 系统，不支持 Linux 或 Windows 平台，且不具备全屏视频录制功能。

skills.name: bilibili-source
skills.summary: Fetch comprehensive, login-free data for any Bilibili (B站) video — title, UP name and follower count, publish date, partition, tags, per-part cids, live stats (view, like, coin, favorite, share, reply, danmaku), and full danmaku (bullet-comment) text. Use this skill whenever working with a Bilibili video and needing real, citable numbers or metadata — ingesting a Bilibili source into a knowledge base, analyzing why a video performed, verifying a creator's claimed metrics, building a case study, or any time a Bilibili view/like/favorite count is about to be written into a document — fetch it, never hand-type or estimate it. Accepts BVID, av numbers, b23.tv short links, or full URLs. Subtitles are also covered but require the user's Bilibili login.

en.purpose: Fetch comprehensive login-free metadata, live engagement statistics, and danmaku text for Bilibili videos.
scenarios: Ingesting accurate Bilibili video metadata and engagement metrics into a knowledge base
Analyzing video performance drivers using live engagement stats and audience danmaku comments
Verifying creator-claimed metrics for case studies and analytical reports
en.io: Accepts Bilibili identifiers (BVID, av number, short link, or URL) and outputs structured JSON containing video metadata, interaction statistics, danmaku transcripts, or subtitles.
en.boundary: It does not download video or audio media files, and it cannot fetch subtitles without a logged-in Bilibili session.

zh.purpose: 获取 Bilibili 视频的元数据、实时互动数据及弹幕文本，为知识库与数据分析提供可核实的权威数据。
scenarios: 将准确的 B 站视频元数据与互动指标导入知识库
结合实时互动数据与弹幕文本分析视频受热捧的原因与互动节点
核实创作者展示的各项数据指标以构建案例研究
zh.io: 输入 B 站视频标识（BVID、av号、b23.tv短链接或完整URL），输出包含视频元数据、实时统计指标、弹幕全文或字幕的结构化数据。
zh.boundary: 本技能不包含视频或音频源文件的下载功能，且在无登录 Cookie 的情况下无法提取字幕。

skills.name: benchmark-due-diligence
skills.summary: Runs adversarial due-diligence on a benchmark the user envies — a founder, KOL, company, or product whose claimed success looks inflated — splitting marketing bubble from real signal, then mapping the validated playbook onto the user's own resources. Use whenever the user wants to 尽调/对标/拆解 a competitor or role-model, 抄/偷师 someone's playbook, suspects 水分/泡沫 in their claims (#1 on Product Hunt, 0-to-1M users, funding, 估值几个亿), asks whether wins are 真本事 vs 运气/时机, or says someone is 太成功了/crushing it and wants the real story — even if they never say 尽调. Prefer over deep-research for debunking inflated claims and extracting a replicable playbook rather than a neutral briefing.

en.purpose: Conducts adversarial due diligence on high-profile competitors or benchmarks to separate PR hype from verified signal and map actionable playbooks onto the user's specific context.
scenarios: Debunking viral traction or inflated funding claims of a competitor
Dissecting a founder or KOL's growth playbook to distinguish luck from replicable methods
Analyzing a benchmark product launch to translate its validated tactics into personalized strategic moves
en.io: Inputs a target benchmark, entity, or claim alongside optional user context, and outputs an adversarial teardown report with a tailored execution plan.
en.boundary: It does not provide neutral, broad market research briefings, nor does it conduct formal legal, financial, or non-public corporate due diligence.

zh.purpose: 对竞争对手或行业标杆进行批判性拆解与深度尽调，剔除营销泡沫，并将验证有效的战术复刻映射至用户自身的实际资源中。
scenarios: 拆解竞品的宣传水分或夸大的融资与增长数据（如 Product Hunt 榜首、虚高估值）
剖析知名 KOL 或创业者的成功路径，区分运气/时机与可复制的底层套路
对标行业标杆产品，将其验证有效的打法转化为适合用户自身资源的落地动作
zh.io: 输入目标标杆对象、宣传主张及用户自身的资源背景，输出一份去泡沫化的竞品拆解报告与定制化复刻方案。
zh.boundary: 它不提供中立客观的广义行业综述报告，也不进行涉及未公开数据的合规法务或审计级财务尽调。

skills.name: auto-repo-setup
skills.summary: Diagnose, repair, and standardize repository setup and safe Git workflows for Claude Code or Codex. Use when a repository will not run, a collaborator is onboarding, dependencies or credentials are missing, the user wants startup sync, SessionStart output is duplicated, project instructions or hooks need auditing, or commit/push/conflict/history-cleanup needs a guarded workflow. Route ordinary startup behavior through project instructions or a natural language request; use lifecycle hooks only when behavior must occur before the first prompt and the target runtime has been verified.

en.purpose: Diagnose, repair, and standardize project environment setups, startup hooks, and safe Git workflows for AI coding agents.
scenarios: Troubleshooting broken project runtimes or missing dependencies on fresh clone environments.
Safely executing Git operations such as commits, pushes, conflict resolutions, and history cleanup.
Auditing and repairing duplicated or failing agent startup hooks and onboarding documentation.
en.io: Takes an optional repository path or user directive as input and produces diagnostic reports, environment repairs, or safe Git action results.
en.boundary: It does not perform destructive Git actions like unapproved stashes or force pushes, nor does it enforce unneeded dependencies on clean repositories.

zh.purpose: 自动诊断、修复并规范 AI 编程 Agent 的项目环境配置、启动钩子与安全的 Git 工作流。
scenarios: 排查并修复新克隆仓库中运行失败的环境或缺失的依赖。
安全地执行提交、推送、冲突解决及敏感历史清理等 Git 操作。
审计并修复重复或异常的 Agent 启动钩子与团队入职文档。
zh.io: 输入可选的仓库路径或自然语言指令，输出诊断报告、修复后的环境或安全的 Git 执行结果。
zh.boundary: 它不会在未经明确许可的情况下执行暂存或强推等破坏性 Git 操作，也不会为未声明的项目强加无关依赖。

skills.name: asr-transcribe-to-text
skills.summary: Transcribe audio/video to speaker-labeled text — who-said-what by default, plain-text opt-out; MLX-local on Apple Silicon or remote; local files, media URLs. Use for transcribing recordings/podcasts/lectures/meetings, ASR, speech-to-text, 转录, 语音转文字, 录音转文字, speaker diarization/说话人分离/识别/谁在说话, timestamps 字幕/时间戳/音画对齐, CAM++ voiceprint ID. This skill ALSO owns audio PREPROCESSING for ASR as a first-class trigger, even without transcription: convert any audio/video into an ASR-ready file (转换成适合 ASR 的格式, 转格式, convert/prepare audio for ASR, 音频预处理), downsample to 16kHz mono 16-bit (降采样, 重采样, 单声道, 归一化), merge multi-segment recorder dumps (多段合并/拼接, DJI TX01/TX02), transcode to small M4A + pitch-preserved speedup to cut metered-ASR billed minutes (转 M4A, 压缩上传, 加速, 1.3x, 飞书妙记/Feishu Minutes). Trigger even when it looks like a trivial one-line ffmpeg — the skill owns sample-rate/bit-depth/channel, merge-order, speed-vs-WER, format choices + a blessed prepare_asr_input.py.

en.purpose: Transcribes audio and video files or URLs into speaker-labeled text and handles audio preprocessing for optimal ASR input.
scenarios: Transcribing meetings, podcasts, or lectures with speaker diarization and word-level timestamps.
Preprocessing and downsampling raw multi-segment audio files into standard 16kHz mono ASR format.
Compressing and speeding up audio files with pitch preservation to reduce metered ASR service costs.
en.io: Inputs local audio/video file paths or media URLs with optional transcription options, and outputs speaker-diarized text transcripts (with CSV/timestamps) or preprocessed audio files.
en.boundary: This skill does not handle real-time streaming speech recognition or directly generate meeting summaries from the transcript.

zh.purpose: 将音视频文件或 URL 转录为带说话人标签的文本，并提供用于优化 ASR 输入的音频预处理功能。
scenarios: 转录包含说话人分离和字级别时间戳的会议、播客或讲座录音。
将多段原始录音进行降采样、单声道化与合并，预处理为适合 ASR 的标准格式。
对音频进行保频倍速压缩和格式转换，以降低按量计费的 ASR 服务的转录成本。
zh.io: 输入本地音视频文件路径或媒体 URL 及转录参数，输出带说话人标识与时间戳的文本/CSV 记录或预处理后的音频文件。
zh.boundary: 该技能不提供实时流式语音识别，也不直接对转录后的文本进行摘要或文档生成。

en.purpose: Audits AI Management System (AIMS) policies, controls, and documentation against standards like ISO/IEC 42001.
scenarios: Evaluating organizational AI governance policies for ISO/IEC 42001 compliance
Generating audit reports and gap analysis for AI risk management controls
Reviewing data governance and model safety documentation before external audits
en.io: Takes AI governance documents, system architecture specs, and risk assessment logs as input, and outputs structured audit reports with remediation recommendations.
en.boundary: Provides AI compliance and process assessment but does not automatically execute technical fixes or replace official certified third-party auditors.

zh.purpose: 根据 ISO/IEC 42001 等标准，对人工智能管理体系（AIMS）的政策、控制措施及文档进行审计评估。
scenarios: 评估企业 AI 治理政策是否符合 ISO/IEC 42001 合规标准
生成 AI 风险管理与安全控制的审计报告及差距分析
在进行外部认证审计前对数据治理和模型安全文档进行自查
zh.io: 输入 AI 治理政策文档、系统架构说明及风险评估日志，输出结构化的审计报告与整改建议。
zh.boundary: 仅提供 AI 合规性与流程评估建议，不能自动修复技术漏洞或替代官方第三方认证审计。

en.purpose: Evaluates, audits, and secures AI models, prompt engineering pipelines, and LLM application architectures against vulnerabilities like prompt injection and data leakage.
scenarios: Auditing system prompts and LLM pipelines for direct and indirect prompt injection vulnerabilities.
Reviewing AI application architectures for secure data handling, access controls, and privacy compliance.
Conducting threat modeling and adversarial risk assessments for autonomous LLM agents.
en.io: Accepts system prompts, model configurations, or application architecture documentation as input, and outputs security risk assessments, threat models, and actionable mitigation guidelines.
en.boundary: Does not perform active automated penetration testing on live infrastructure or guarantee absolute immunity against novel zero-day AI attack vectors.

zh.purpose: 评估、审计和保护 AI 模型、提示词工程流水线及 LLM 应用架构，抵御提示词注入和数据泄露等安全漏洞。
scenarios: 审计系统提示词和 LLM 流水线中的直接与间接提示词注入漏洞。
审查 AI 应用架构的数据处理安全性、访问控制与隐私合规性。
对自主 LLM 智能体进行威胁建模和对抗性风险评估。
zh.io: 接受系统提示词、模型配置或应用架构文档作为输入，输出安全风险评估报告、威胁模型及可操作的修复建议。
zh.boundary: 不针对线上基础设施执行自动化渗透测试，也不保证绝对防御未知的 AI 零日攻击手段。

en.purpose: Evaluates AI models, applications, and workflows against EU AI Act requirements to assess risk categories and compliance readiness.
scenarios: Classifying AI systems into EU AI Act risk tiers (e.g., Prohibited, High-Risk, GPAI).
Identifying compliance gaps and documentation needs prior to EU market deployment.
Generating AI governance readiness checklists and risk mitigation roadmaps.
en.io: Inputs AI system descriptions, data usage, and deployment context; outputs an EU AI Act compliance readiness report with risk classifications and recommendations.
en.boundary: Does not provide legally binding legal advice or substitute for official regulatory audits and certifications by notified bodies.

zh.purpose: 根据欧盟《人工智能法案》（EU AI Act）评估 AI 模型、应用和工作流的风险等级与合规准备度。
scenarios: 对 AI 系统进行欧盟 AI 法案下的风险等级划分（如禁止类、高风险类、通用 AI 等）。
在进入欧盟市场前识别合规差距及所需的文档规范。
生成 AI 治理准备度检查清单与风险缓解路线图。
zh.io: 输入 AI 系统的架构描述、数据使用及部署场景；输出包含风险分类与改进建议的欧盟 AI 法案合规评估报告。
zh.boundary: 不提供具有法律约束力的法律咨询，也不能替代监管机构或公告机构的正式合规认证。

en.purpose: Helps product and engineering teams translate business goals into actionable agile backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
scenarios: Writing detailed user stories using the Given-When-Then format and INVEST principles
Prioritizing product backlogs based on business value, effort, and strategic goals
Breaking down large product epics into manageable, sprint-ready features
Facilitating backlog refinement by clarifying functional requirements and edge cases
en.io: Inputs high-level business ideas or requirements; outputs prioritized user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature roadmaps.
en.boundary: Does not write production code, design software architecture, or manage daily Scrum Master operations like standup facilitation.

zh.purpose: 帮助产品与工程团队将业务目标转化为可执行的敏捷 Backlog、用户故事与验收标准。
scenarios: 使用 Given-When-Then 格式和 INVEST 原则编写详细的用户故事
根据业务价值、开发成本和战略目标对产品 Backlog 进行优先级排序
将大型 Epic 拆解为可在 Sprint 内交付的具体功能项
在需求精炼会中澄清业务规则与边界情况
zh.io: 输入高层业务想法或原始需求，输出结构化的用户故事、验收标准及优先级需求列表。
zh.boundary: 不负责编写技术实现代码、设计系统架构，也不承担 Scrum Master 的日常站会主持与团队敏捷流程管理工作。

en.purpose: AgentHub serves as a centralized management platform for discovering, registering, and orchestrating specialized AI agents and skills.
scenarios: Querying and listing available AI agents and their capabilities
Registering or updating agent configurations and skill definitions
Routing user requests to appropriate specialized agents for task execution
en.io: Accepts agent management commands or task routing queries as input, and outputs agent metadata, status, or routed execution results.
en.boundary: It handles agent lifecycle management and task routing but does not execute domain-specific task logic directly.

zh.purpose: AgentHub 是一个用于发现、注册和编排专业化 AI 智能体与技能的集中式管理平台。
scenarios: 查询并列出可用的 AI 智能体及其功能技能
注册或更新智能体配置与技能定义
将用户请求路由至适当的专用智能体以执行任务
zh.io: 输入为智能体管理指令或任务路由查询，输出为智能体元信息、状态或已路由任务的执行结果。
zh.boundary: 它仅负责智能体生命周期管理与任务路由，本身不直接执行具体的领域业务逻辑。

en.purpose: Design, architect, and optimize multi-agent workflows, state machines, and task orchestration pipelines for complex AI systems.
scenarios: Architecting complex multi-agent collaborative workflows or directed acyclic graphs (DAGs).
Designing state transitions, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and fallback mechanisms for AI agent tasks.
Defining optimal prompt chaining structures and tool routing logic for autonomous agent execution.

en.boundary: This skill focuses on designing workflow architecture and specifications, but does not execute agents at runtime, manage live database state, or deploy infrastructure.

zh.purpose: 设计、构建和优化用于复杂 AI 系统的多 Agent 工作流、状态机及任务编排管线。

为 Agent 任务设计状态迁移、人工干预检查点及容错回退机制。

en.purpose: Provides a standardized protocol and interaction specification for task execution, step tracking, and communication between AI agents.

Interfacing heterogeneous agent frameworks using a common communication layer.
Logging and monitoring step-by-step agent execution histories.
en.io: Inputs task requests, step payloads, and agent configuration data; outputs standardized execution status, step responses, and task artifacts.
en.boundary: Defines interface specifications and data schemas for agent communication, but does not implement domain-specific business logic or host agent execution runtimes.

zh.purpose: 为 AI Agent 之间的任务执行、步骤跟踪和通信提供标准化的协议与交互规范。
scenarios: 标准化多 Agent 任务分发与状态跟踪的 API 接口。
通过统一的通信层连接异构 Agent 框架。
记录和监控 Agent 的分步执行历史与中间状态。
zh.io: 输入任务请求、步骤载荷与 Agent 配置数据；输出标准化的执行状态、步骤响应与任务产物。
zh.boundary: 仅定义 Agent 通信的接口规范与数据结构，不实现具体的业务领域逻辑，也不托管 Agent 的底层运行环境。

en.purpose: Provides a standardized execution framework and test harness for running, evaluating, and debugging LLM agents.
scenarios: Running automated benchmarks and test suites for agents
Simulating execution environments and tool interactions during agent development
Debugging step-by-step agent reasoning traces and tool invocations
en.io: Takes agent configurations, task prompts, and test suites as input, and outputs execution logs, evaluation metrics, and diagnostic reports.
en.boundary: It manages agent execution environments and evaluations, but does not build LLM models or automatically author agent prompts.

zh.purpose: 提供一个用于运行、评估和调试 LLM Agent 的标准化执行框架与测试套件。
scenarios: 为 Agent 运行自动化基准测试与评估集
在开发过程中模拟 Agent 的执行环境与工具交互
调试 Agent 的分步推理轨迹与工具调用过程

en.purpose: Designs and scaffolds custom AI agents and agent skills by defining their architecture, system prompts, and tool configurations.
scenarios: Scaffolding a new agent configuration for a specific task domain
Drafting SKILL.md specifications and prompt guidelines for custom skills
Structuring agent workflows and interaction patterns
en.io: Input is target requirements or domain specs for an agent; output is a structured agent design blueprint or SKILL.md definition.

zh.purpose: 通过定义架构、系统提示词和工具配置，设计并构建自定义 AI Agent 及其 Skill 规范。
scenarios: 针对特定任务领域搭建全新的 Agent 配置
为自定义技能编写 SKILL.md 规范与提示词指南
规划 Agent 的工作流与交互模式
zh.io: 输入为 Agent 的需求描述或领域规范，输出为结构化的 Agent 设计蓝图或 SKILL.md 定义文件。
zh.boundary: 不负责将设计好的 Agent 部署或运行到实际的生产环境中。

en.purpose: Generates structured, traceable audit receipts for AI agent decisions to ensure accountability and transparency in automated workflows.
scenarios: Recording audit logs for compliance in automated financial or legal agent actions.
Tracking decision rationales and metadata across multi-agent execution pipelines.
Verifying agent policy compliance during post-execution system audits.
en.io: Takes agent execution states, decision contexts, and metadata as input, and outputs standardized, immutable decision receipt records.
en.boundary: It does not execute business logic or make autonomous decisions, focusing exclusively on capturing and formatting decision receipts.

scenarios: 记录自动化金融或法律Agent操作的合规审计日志。
在多Agent协同流程中追踪决策依据与上下文元数据。
在事后系统审计期间核实Agent对既定策略的执行合规性。

en.purpose: Optimizes website content and brand messaging for AI answer engines and generative search platforms (Answer Engine Optimization).
scenarios: Auditing brand visibility and citation rates across conversational AI engines.
Structuring web content and schema markup to increase direct citations in AI responses.
Benchmarking competitor presence and share of voice in AI-generated answer engines.

优化网页结构与 Schema 标记以提升被 AI 直接引用的概率。
对标竞品在 AI 生成回答中的曝光率与声量占比。

en.purpose: Critically evaluates code, designs, or proposals by acting as an adversarial reviewer to uncover security vulnerabilities, edge cases, hidden assumptions, and failure modes.
scenarios: Reviewing pull requests for subtle security risks and unhandled edge cases
Stress-testing architectural designs to identify single points of failure before implementation
Auditing refactoring proposals to detect potential regression risks and breaking changes
en.io: Accepts code diffs, architecture specs, or pull requests as input, and outputs a structured adversarial assessment detailing identified risks and potential failure scenarios.
en.boundary: It focuses strictly on identifying flaws and risks, and does not automatically generate code fixes or approve pull requests.

Adding @MainActor annotations or Sendable conformances to UI types and global state.
Migrating legacy completion handler APIs to modern async/await syntax.
en.io: Accepts Swift source code and compiler concurrency diagnostics as inputs, and produces concurrency-compliant, refactored Swift code as outputs.
en.boundary: It does not perform general Swift code refactoring unrelated to concurrency, major architecture redesigns, or support Swift versions prior to Swift 6.2.

zh.purpose: 审查并修复 Swift 6.2+ 代码库中的 Swift 并发问题，通过应用 Actor 隔离、Sendable 安全性和现代异步模式消除数据竞争。
scenarios: 修复 Swift 编译器的并发报错、数据竞争警告与 Actor 隔离诊断问题。
为 UI 绑定的 ViewModel 或全局状态添加 @MainActor 标注与 Sendable 协议实现。
将遗留的 completion handler 回调接口重构迁移为 async/await 异步代码。
zh.io: 输入 Swift 源码及编译器并发诊断日志，输出修复并符合 Swift 6.2+ 并发规范的 Swift 源码。
zh.boundary: 不负责与并发无关的通用 Swift 代码重构、整体架构调整以及 Swift 6.2 以下旧版本的并发适配。

skills.name: review-swarm
skills.summary: Parallel read-only multi-agent review of a current git diff or explicit file scope to find behavioral regressions, security or privacy risks, performance or reliability issues, and contract or test coverage gaps. Use when the user asks for a review swarm, parallel review, diff review, regression review, security review, or wants high-signal issues plus a prioritized fix path without editing files.

en.purpose: Performs a parallel, multi-agent read-only review on git diffs or specified files to detect behavioral regressions, security risks, performance bottlenecks, and test coverage gaps.
scenarios: Reviewing pending git diffs before submitting a PR or committing changes
Running multi-perspective security and behavioral regression checks on modified files
Analyzing branch or commit comparisons for performance risks and contract gaps
en.io: Accepts git diffs, branch comparisons, or explicit file paths as input, and outputs a prioritized, filtered summary of critical issues alongside recommended fix paths.
en.boundary: This skill is strictly read-only and will not edit files, apply patches, stage changes, or automatically execute code fixes.

zh.purpose: 通过多 Agent 并行只读审查 git diff 或指定文件，综合检测代码的行为回归、安全风险、性能隐患及测试覆盖缺口。
scenarios: 在提交代码或创建 PR 前对当前 git 变更进行多维度并行审查
对修改的文件进行专项安全、隐私风险与行为回归排查
评估分支对比中的性能瓶颈、契约失效与测试缺口
zh.io: 输入 git 变更、分支对比或指定文件路径，输出按优先级排序的高价值问题汇总及建议修复路径。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅执行只读审查，绝不修改文件、应用补丁、暂存变更或自动应用任何修复。

skills.name: review-and-simplify-changes
skills.summary: Review a git diff or explicit file scope for reuse, code quality, efficiency, clarity, and standards issues, then optionally apply safe Codex-driven fixes. Use when the user asks to \"simplify code\", \"review changed code\", \"check for code reuse\", \"review code quality\", \"review efficiency\", \"simplify changes\", \"clean up code\", \"refactor changes\", or \"run simplify\".

en.purpose: Reviews git diffs or specific files for code reuse, quality, efficiency, and clarity issues using parallel read-only sub-agents, optionally applying safe, behavior-preserving fixes.
scenarios: Auditing git diffs before committing to ensure code quality and avoid duplicated logic.
Simplifying and cleaning up recent code changes to improve efficiency and maintainability.
Checking specific files against local repository standards and running validation tests post-refactor.
en.io: Inputs a git diff, file scope, and operational mode (review-only, safe-fixes, or fix-and-validate); outputs structured review findings and optionally safe code edits.
en.boundary: Does not apply unsafe or speculative code changes, nor does it allow review sub-agents to directly mutate workspace state or edit files.

zh.purpose: 利用并行只读子代理审查 Git 变动或指定文件中的代码复用、质量、效率及规范问题，并可选择性地应用安全的重构修复。
scenarios: 在代码提交前审查暂存区或工作区的 Git 变更，检查是否存在重复逻辑和质量问题
对近期修改的代码进行简化和重构，以提升代码可读性与执行效率
针对指定文件核对本地项目规范，并在修改后执行基础校验测试
zh.io: 输入为 Git 差异范围、指定文件路径及操作模式（仅审查、安全修复或修复并验证），输出为结构化审查报告及可选的安全代码修改。
zh.boundary: 不会执行低置信度或改变原有行为的破坏性重构，且禁止审查子代理直接修改文件或变更工作区状态。

skills.name: react-component-performance
skills.summary: Analyze and optimize React component performance issues (slow renders, re-render thrash, laggy lists, expensive computations). Use when asked to profile or improve a React component, reduce re-renders, or speed up UI updates in React apps.

en.purpose: Provides systematic patterns and workflows to identify, isolate, and optimize React component performance bottlenecks without altering UI functionality.
scenarios: Diagnosing and fixing re-render thrash or UI lag in React components
Optimizing heavy lists and expensive calculations using virtualization and memoization
Isolating fast-changing state and stabilizing callbacks/props to reduce unnecessary re-renders
en.io: Inputs React component source code or performance profiling data and outputs optimized React code along with profiling recommendations.
en.boundary: Does not address backend network latency, server-side performance issues, or non-React frontend framework optimizations.

zh.purpose: 提供系统化的模式和工作流，用于在不修改 UI 功能的前提下识别、隔离并优化 React 组件的性能瓶颈。
scenarios: 排查并修复 React 组件中的渲染卡顿和频繁无用重渲染问题
通过虚拟化和记忆化技术优化大列表渲染与高开销计算
隔离高频变动状态并稳定回调函数与 Props 以防止组件级联渲染
zh.io: 输入 React 组件源码或性能分析数据，输出优化后的 React 代码及性能验证建议。
zh.boundary: 不涉及后端网络延迟、服务器端性能调优或非 React 前端框架的性能优化。

skills.name: project-skill-audit
skills.summary: Analyze a project's past Codex sessions, memory files, and existing local skills to recommend the highest-value skills to create or update. Use when a user asks what skills a project needs, wants skill ideas grounded in real project history, wants an audit of current project-local skills, or wants recommendations for updating stale or incomplete skills instead of creating duplicates.

en.purpose: Analyzes past project sessions, memory files, and existing local skills to recommend high-value skill creations or updates based on real recurring workflows.
scenarios: Evaluating project history to discover recurring manual workflows that should be turned into skills
Auditing project-local skills for stale paths, weak validation, or missing guardrails
Deciding whether to update an existing skill or create a new project-local skill without duplicating generic global skills
en.io: Inputs project repository files, memory logs, and local skill directories, and outputs actionable recommendations for creating or updating project-specific skills.
en.boundary: This skill only analyzes session history and provides skill recommendations; it does not automatically draft or generate the full skill implementation files.

zh.purpose: 通过分析项目历史 Session 记录、Memory 日志和现有本地 Skill，识别高频工作流并推荐最具价值的新增或更新建议。
scenarios: 评估项目历史会话，提取可自动化的重复性工作流并推荐新 Skill
审计现有项目本地 Skill，查找过期的路径、缺失的校验步骤或失效的触发条件
基于历史证据判断应当优化现有 Skill 还是新建专属 Skill，避免与全局 Skill 重复
zh.io: 输入项目文件、Memory 索引及本地 Skill 目录，输出包含 Skill 新增或更新建议的分析报告。
zh.boundary: 该 Skill 仅负责分析历史记录并输出针对性的 Skill 优化与新建建议，不会自动创建或修改 Skill 文件。

skills.name: orchestrate-batch-refactor
skills.summary: Plan and execute large refactor or rewrite efforts efficiently with parallel multi-agent analysis and implementation. Use when a user asks to refactor many files, split workstreams, analyze a target code area, and coordinate sub-agents with clear ownership and dependency-aware execution.

en.purpose: Plan and execute large-scale refactoring or rewrite tasks efficiently using parallel multi-agent analysis and dependency-aware task execution.
scenarios: Refactoring medium-to-large codebases spanning multiple modules or subsystems.
Decomposing large code migration efforts into independent, parallel work packets.
Coordinating multi-agent exploration and implementation with strict file ownership boundaries.
en.io: Inputs include repository paths, refactor scope, and constraints, while outputs include an integrated execution plan, refactored code, and validation summaries.
en.boundary: It does not allow parallel edits on overlapping files and is not intended for tiny, tightly coupled single-file edits that do not benefit from multi-agent parallelization.

zh.purpose: 通过多 Agent 并行分析与依赖感知的分工执行，高效规划并实施大规模代码重构或重写。
scenarios: 涉及多个模块或子系统的大中型代码库重构
将大型代码迁移或重写任务拆解为独立的并行工作包
协调多个子 Agent 进行代码探索与严格隔离文件所有权的并行修改
zh.io: 输入包括仓库路径、重构范围及约束条件，输出包括结构化重构计划、代码变更及最终验证报告。
zh.boundary: 它不适用于无需并行拆解的微小或高度耦合的单文件修改，也不允许对存在重叠的文件集进行并行修改。

skills.name: macos-spm-app-packaging
skills.summary: Scaffold, build, and package SwiftPM-based macOS apps without an Xcode project. Use when you need a from-scratch macOS app layout, SwiftPM targets/resources, a custom .app bundle assembly script, or signing/notarization/appcast steps outside Xcode.

en.purpose: Scaffolds, builds, packages, signs, and notarizes SwiftPM-based macOS applications entirely from the command line without an Xcode project file.
scenarios: Bootstrapping a lightweight macOS app directory using Swift Package Manager without Xcode.
Assembling and packaging compiled binaries and resources into a standalone .app bundle using custom shell scripts.
Automating code signing, Apple notarization, stapling, and Sparkle appcast generation for non-Xcode release pipelines.
en.io: Inputs include Swift package sources, metadata files (Package.swift, version.env), and Apple Developer signing credentials; outputs are a packaged .app bundle, a signed release zip file, and an appcast XML.
en.boundary: This skill does not generate or manage Xcode project (.xcodeproj) files, build iOS/mobile targets, or submit apps directly to the Mac App Store.

zh.purpose: 在无需 Xcode 项目文件的情况下，完全通过命令行对基于 SwiftPM 的 macOS 应用进行脚手架构建、打包、签名和公证。
scenarios: 在不依赖 Xcode 的情况下，使用 Swift Package Manager 从零初始化轻量级 macOS 应用框架。
通过 Shell 脚本将编译出的二进制文件与资源整合并打包为独立的 .app 应用包。
在非 Xcode 的发布流水线中自动化执行代码签名、Apple 公证、票据钉合（Stapling）以及 Sparkle Appcast 生成。
zh.io: 输入包括 Swift 包源码、元数据配置文件（Package.swift、version.env）及开发者签名凭证；输出为打包好的 .app Bundle、已签名的发布 zip 压缩包和 appcast XML 文件。
zh.boundary: 该技能不创建或管理 Xcode 项目文件（.xcodeproj），不支持构建 iOS/移动端应用，也不处理向 Mac App Store 的直接提交流程。

skills.name: macos-menubar-tuist-app
skills.summary: Build, refactor, or review macOS menubar apps that use Tuist and SwiftUI. Use when creating or maintaining LSUIElement menubar utilities, defining Tuist targets/manifests, implementing model-client-store-view architecture, adding script-based launch flows, or validating reliable local build/run behavior without Xcode-first workflows.

en.purpose: Provides standard workflows and architecture rules for building, refactoring, and maintaining macOS menubar apps using Tuist and SwiftUI.
scenarios: Creating a new macOS menubar app using Tuist manifests and SwiftUI.
Refactoring app state and networking logic into a Model-Client-Store-View architecture.
Setting up script-based local build and launch flows without relying on raw Xcode workflows.
en.io: Inputs include app specifications, code changes, or Tuist manifests, and outputs include structured SwiftUI source files, Tuist configurations, and shell launch scripts.
en.boundary: This skill strictly targets macOS menubar-only utilities using Tuist and does not cover general iOS application development or Xcode-GUI-driven setups.

zh.purpose: 提供基于 Tuist 和 SwiftUI 构建、重构及维护 macOS 菜单栏应用的标准工作流与架构规范。
scenarios: 使用 Tuist 清单与 SwiftUI 创建新的 macOS 菜单栏应用。
按 Model-Client-Store-View 架构重构应用的状态管理与网络逻辑。
配置并验证基于脚本的本地编译与启动运行流程。
zh.io: 输入包括应用需求、代码修改或 Tuist 清单，输出包括分层的 SwiftUI 源码、Tuist 配置文件及 Shell 运行脚本。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅专注于基于 Tuist 的 macOS 菜单栏应用开发，不包含通用 iOS 应用开发或完全依赖 Xcode GUI 的项目维护。

skills.name: ios-debugger-agent
skills.summary: Use XcodeBuildMCP to build, run, launch, and debug the current iOS project on a booted simulator. Trigger when asked to run an iOS app, interact with the simulator UI, inspect on-screen state, capture logs/console output, or diagnose runtime behavior using XcodeBuildMCP tools.

en.purpose: Uses XcodeBuildMCP tools to build, launch, interact with, and debug iOS applications on a booted Xcode simulator.
scenarios: Building and launching an iOS project on a booted simulator
Interacting with simulator UI using taps, text inputs, gestures, and capturing screenshots
Capturing and analyzing runtime console logs to diagnose application crashes or bugs
en.io: Takes project paths, scheme names, and UI action commands as inputs, and outputs build status, UI layout descriptions, screenshots, and app logs.
en.boundary: It does not support debugging on physical iOS devices and will not automatically boot closed simulators without user permission.

zh.purpose: 使用 XcodeBuildMCP 工具在已启动的 iOS 模拟器上构建、运行、UI 交互与调试 iOS 应用程序。
scenarios: 在已启动的模拟器上构建并运行 iOS 应用项目
通过点击、文本输入、手势及截图对模拟器 UI 进行交互和状态检查
捕获并分析应用运行时的控制台日志以诊断程序异常
zh.io: 输入项目路径、Scheme 配置和 UI 操作指令，输出构建状态、UI 视图结构、界面截图及应用日志。
zh.boundary: 该技能不支持真机设备调试，且不会在未获明确指令的情况下自动启动未开启的模拟器。

skills.name: github
skills.summary: Interact with GitHub using the `gh` CLI. Use `gh issue`, `gh pr`, `gh run`, and `gh api` for issues, PRs, CI runs, and advanced queries. Use when the user asks about GitHub issues, pull requests, workflows, or wants to interact with GitHub repositories from the command line — including tasks like check CI status, create PR, list issues, or query the GitHub API.

en.purpose: Provides interaction capabilities with GitHub repositories, pull requests, issues, and CI/CD workflow runs using the official `gh` CLI.
scenarios: Investigating and fetching logs for failing CI workflow runs
Checking pull request status and CI check results
Querying issues and PRs with custom JSON formatting using jq
en.io: Accepts repository identifiers, issue/PR numbers, or workflow run IDs as inputs, and outputs command execution results, PR/issue statuses, or log data.
en.boundary: It does not handle direct local git version control actions like committing or editing repository code outside of `gh` CLI capabilities.

zh.purpose: 通过官方 `gh` 命令行工具实现对 GitHub 仓库、Pull Request、Issue 和 CI/CD 工作流的交互与查询。
scenarios: 排查 CI 工作流构建失败原因并提取失败步骤日志
查看 Pull Request 的状态以及自动化 Check 结果
通过 JQ 过滤器自定义查询 Issue 与 PR 列表数据
zh.io: 输入为 GitHub 仓库标识、PR/Issue 编号或 Workflow Run ID 等参数，输出为对应的 GitHub API 数据、状态信息或日志内容。
zh.boundary: 该技能不处理本地 Git 提交、分支合并等超出了 `gh` CLI 范围的纯本地代码仓库操作。

skills.name: bug-hunt-swarm
skills.summary: Parallel read-only multi-agent root-cause investigation for bugs, regressions, crashes, flaky behavior, or unexplained failures. Use when the user asks to investigate a bug, find the root cause, trace a regression, understand why something broke, or wants a ranked diagnosis with the fastest proof path without making code edits.

en.purpose: Orchestrates a parallel, multi-agent read-only investigation to determine the root cause of software bugs, regressions, or unexpected failures without modifying any code.
scenarios: Diagnosing intermittent failures or flaky tests in complex codebases.
Tracing regressions introduced by recent commit histories or diffs.
Analyzing bug descriptions and stack traces to rank candidate root causes and minimal proof steps.
en.io: Inputs bug symptoms, stack traces, logs, and git history, and outputs a ranked diagnosis of potential root causes with the fastest path to proof.
en.boundary: This skill performs strictly read-only analysis and will not edit workspace files, apply patches, or implement code fixes.

zh.purpose: 通过编排四个只读子智能体并行调查，在不修改任何代码的前提下精确定位软件 Bug、回归或异常故障的根本原因。
scenarios: 诊断复杂代码库中的偶发性测试失败或不稳定行为。
追踪由近期提交记录或差异对比引入的功能回归问题。
分析 Bug 症状与堆栈日志并输出按可能性排序的故障原因及最快验证路径。
zh.io: 输入 Bug 现象描述、堆栈信息、日志和 Git 历史记录，输出排序后的诊断报告与最小验证步骤建议。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅执行只读诊断，绝不会修改工作区文件、应用补丁或编写代码修复。

skills.name: app-store-changelog
skills.summary: Create user-facing App Store release notes by collecting and summarizing all user-impacting changes since the last git tag (or a specified ref). Use when asked to generate a comprehensive release changelog, App Store "What's New" text, or release notes based on git history or tags.

en.purpose: Generates user-facing App Store release notes by collecting and summarizing user-impacting changes from git history since the last tag.
scenarios: Generating 'What's New' text for an upcoming App Store release
Filtering git commit history to extract user-visible features and bug fixes
Translating technical commit messages into non-technical, benefit-focused bullet points
en.io: Accepts an optional git tag or reference range as input and outputs a formatted bulleted list of App Store release notes.
en.boundary: It strictly excludes internal technical changes like CI or refactoring and does not directly publish notes to App Store Connect.

zh.purpose: 通过收集并总结自上个 Git 标签以来对用户有影响的变更，自动生成面向用户的 App Store 更新日志。
scenarios: 为即将发布的 App Store 新版本撰写“新功能/更新内容”文本
过滤 Git 提交历史，仅提取用户可见的新功能与缺陷修复
将技术性的代码提交转化为面向用户的非技术性更新要点
zh.io: 输入可选的 Git 标签或版本范围，输出格式化的面向用户的 App Store 更新日志列表。
zh.boundary: 它会过滤掉纯内部技术变更（如 CI、代码重构、依赖升级），且不会自动提交或发布日志到 App Store Connect。
